_about: Traps (need power; core/trap_state.gd, game/traps.gd). Each is switched on at its lever for `price` points, runs `seconds`, then cools down `cooldown` seconds. electric = a coil on a hut's roof (`hut` = which shelter): every `tick` seconds enemies within `radius` of the hut but outside it lose `trash_share` of their full health (a boss `boss_share`); fire = a pit (island + at): enemies within `radius` burn, and so does a player standing in it (`player_damage` a tick). Their kills pay nobody.
